panel: not in paper — exploratory cross-modal encoder test
note: HDGM vectors reshaped into a zero-padded 2x2 grid, upsampled to 224x224, repeated to 3ch, embedded via frozen DINOv2. This vector-to-image encoding is one specific, arbitrary choice — the spatial structure DINOv2 attends over is an artifact of this reshape, not real structure in the data (unlike MNIST). Phase 1 runs per-trial since HDGM is freshly generated each trial. Phase 2 unchanged C2ST_NN_fit.
